Titanic, blind earthworm that drips a constant mucus. Mindless devourers capable of digesting anything.

AC 14, HP 49, ATK 2 bite (near) +7 (2d12 + swallow) or 1 spout mucus, MV double near (burrow), S +6, D -1, C +4, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 10

Spout Mucus. A straight line (5' wide) extending double near from bhole. DEX 15+ or coated in sticky mucus and entangled for 1d4 rounds.

Swallow. On a natural attack roll of 18-20, target is swallowed. Total darkness inside and 2d10 damage per round. Worm regurgitates all swallowed if dealt at least 20 damage in one round to the inside of its gullet.
